models.name: Qwen3.8-27B DFlash2 on Strix Halo
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL + DFlash2 Q8_0 drafter on Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S
models.why: TeksEdge on the DFlash 2 speculative-decoding PR for llama.cpp (PR #27342, still open, needs the PR/fork build): on a Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S Strix Halo, Qwen3.8-27B UD-Q4_K_XL decodes at 26.39 t/s at 0K and 21.11 t/s at 32K with DFlash 2 (n=4), versus 11.81 and 10.54 t/s without it

engines.hardware: Ryzen AI Max+ 395 / Radeon 8060S (Strix Halo), Vulkan backend
engines.quant: UD-Q4_K_XL target + Qwen3.8-27B-DFlash2 Q8_0 drafter; DFlash 2 speculative decoding n=4; 0K context (21.11 t/s at 32K, 21.58 at 8K)
engines.engine_min_version: llama.cpp PR #27342 (DFlash 2 speculative decoding, not yet merged — PR/fork build)

models.name: Qwen3.8-27B on Radeon AI PRO R9700 (llama.cpp Vulkan)
models.full_name: Qwen3.8-27B 27B dense on a 32GB Radeon AI PRO R9700
models.why: AMD's own day-0 validation relayed by XFX Japan: the 27B dense model on one Radeon AI PRO R9700 32GB under Windows ran llama.cpp with the Vulkan backend and MTP=2 at up to 51.8 tok/s generation; Mayhem4Markets measured close to 50 t/s on the same card at 256K context with an 8-bit KV cache

engines.quant: Vulkan backend; MTP=2; Windows (vendor preliminary validation)
Vulkan; 256K context with 8-bit KV cache (16-bit KV similar)
